en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small settlement nestled at the foot of terraced vineyard hills. A road with street lamps runs through the foreground, lined with modest houses and garden plots. On the right stands a larger manor‑like building with a decorative roof, and other farm or estate buildings nearby. The slopes behind are divided into many horizontal terraces, likely for wine cultivation. Red printed German text appears in the lower right, with a printer's line at the very bottom and a handwritten number in red ink at the top.
